summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL), a London-domiciled foreign private issuer, disclosed results of its cash tender offer for the Regulation S interests in its 2.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2028. At the September 15, 2026 London deadline, EUR 342.207 million of the EUR 500 million outstanding was validly tendered and not withdrawn; the company intends to accept all of it, leaving EUR 157.793 million outstanding. The purchase is funded from proceeds of a newly priced EUR 500 million 4.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032, settling September 17, 2026, with tender settlement expected September 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Deutsche Bank and Banco Santander served as joint lead dealer managers; Credit Agricole CIB and ING were co-dealer managers. Watch the 2032 settlement risk and residual 2028 note liquidity.
